metric: Arithmetic mean of paired MiniLM cosine over all scorable public agent-message references, assigning zero to missing or wholly unknown predictions. Partial-unknown predictions retain their archived raw cosine. Task status, discarded messages, and unscorable references are excluded. Not percent accuracy.
classification_policy: Use the historical prediction status when an original classification exists; verify it against the hashed historical report. Otherwise, only an explicitly fresh decoder-config report may use its archived raw-parser status. No new semantic classification is performed.
